CI can distinguish 'we already knew about this one' from 'someone just

So this file can only shrink. Every entry names the refactor phase that

The list is kept sorted by (rule, source, import) so diffs stay readable.
_empty: Phase 8 drained the last entry (R6, admin_router -> sqlalchemy), so the
file is empty and every rule is now a hard rule: an absent rule id means
zero violations and no permission to add one.
The entry was not a lapse. The admin endpoints read SecurityAlert and
AuditEvent, which are security-context concepts, from a router inside the
user context. R2 forbids importing another context's domain, so the router
had no port to ask and imported the ORM models instead. Moving the router
into the context that owns the data is what made the query movable; see
This file stays in the repository rather than being deleted, because the
next violation will be exactly as tempting as this one was and the
instruction not to add an entry is only worth something if there is
somewhere obvious to add it instead.
